speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Manpower given the recent fatal accident at a demolition site (a) whether there will be additional safety measures for demolition works and additional penalties for infringements given the inherent danger for such construction works; and (b) what are the current penalties aimed at making the leadership of construction contractors accountable in preventing accidents and deaths from happening.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: All occupiers and employers have the duty to provide a safe work environment for workers.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The Multi-Agency Workplace Safety Taskforce (MAST) had also earlier announced a set of Safety Accountability, Focus and Empowerment (SAFE) measures to strengthen WSH ownership across the entire ecosystem at the sectoral, company and worker levels.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This programme aims to focus their attention on how to meet their WSH responsibilities and develop their company's WSH capabilities.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Every worker deserves a safe and healthy work environment.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: All of us, corporate senior leadership, industry associations, union leaders and workers, must continue to play our part to uplift WSH and prevent workplace incidents from happening.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Are construction workers trained to recognise tell-tale signs of structural collapse in demolition works and what are the reporting channels for such incidents?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: And does the Building and Construction Authority (BCA) require having Safety Officers on site to ensure that demolition workers are carried out according to plans by the contractors?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: And, therefore, that is why we have the Approved Code of Practice, SS 557, in place.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: All companies involved, from the main contractors all the way down, should be following and training their workers on this practice, Code of Practice.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, therefore, employers are required to train the workers on the demolition process, and this also includes identifying the structural issues that you might see on site.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, I cannot comment specific to this particular case as investigations are ongoing, but we will release the results once they are ready.
